description: This Java class defines the 'StreamThings' command used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It models a command to start or resume a search for streams of thing IDs, including filtering, namespacing, and sorting options. The class provides methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, setting search parameters, and serializing to JSON, indicating its role as a core component in command handling for thing search queries within the project.

classes.name: StreamThings
classes.description: A command class representing a request to stream or search for thing IDs within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes parameters such as filter, namespaces, sort option, and sort values, with methods for construction, JSON serialization/deserialization, and parameter modification.
